concerns.text: The plan treats weekly AI‑companion usage frequency and session duration as proxies for parasocial relationship strength, citing only a correlation (r > 0.70) from Lee et al., 2023. This indirect validation may be insufficient for construct validity; the proxy could capture general platform engagement rather than the specific parasocial construct.

The Monte‑Carlo power simulation targets power ≥ 0.80 for an effect size d = 0.5 but does not disclose key assumptions (intraclass correlation, number of observations per user, variance components). Without these details the simulation may over‑estimate power for the mixed‑effects model with random slopes.

Fixed effects include age and gender but omit other plausible confounders (e.g., overall Reddit activity, baseline mental‑health scores, socioeconomic status). Their exclusion could bias the estimated association between AI usage and loneliness.

The subgroup analysis for users aged ≥ 60 requires ≥ 80 users, yet the plan provides no recruitment or sampling strategy to ensure this demographic is represented, risking an under‑powered subgroup test.
